definitions.explanation: an organizational unit within a company or institution

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{部署|ぶしょ}に{異動|いどう}した。
examples.english: I was transferred to a new department.

examples.japanese: {各|かく}{部署|ぶしょ}の{代表者|だいひょうしゃ}が{集|あつ}まった。
この{案件|あんけん}はどの{部署|ぶしょ}が{担当|たんとう}していますか。
examples.english: Which department is in charge of this matter?

notes:
USAGE:
- {部署|ぶしょ}{異動|いどう} (department transfer)
- {部署|ぶしょ}を{移|うつ}る (to move to another department)
- {各|かく}{部署|ぶしょ} (each department)
- {担当|たんとう}{部署|ぶしょ} (department in charge)

COMPARISON:
- {部署|ぶしょ} - organizational section, post
- {部門|ぶもん} - division, field (broader)
- {課|か} - section, subsection (smaller unit)
- {部|ぶ} - department (often larger)
